cells.value: Manufactured in welded and seamless. Grade B is most commonly specified.
Seamless. Grade B is preferred and mostly used. In the modern plant, almost all carbon steel pipe is this specification.
Used for sub-zero temperatures. Incorporates special testing. For use to -50°F.
Basically a carbon steel with ½% molybdenum. Used in medium high temperature service.
1¼% chrome, ½% molybdenum. Used in higher temperature, corrosive services.
5% chrome, ½% molybdenum. Used in higher temperature, corrosive services.
9% chrome, 1% molybdenum. Used in high temperature highly corrosive services.
Used for temperatures below -50°F and for corrosive service at higher temperatures. Widely used for food product piping.
Used for high temperature, highly corrosive service.

Used in harder conditions than Type 321 stainless.
3½% nickel. Used for temperatures from -50°F to -150°F.
